nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) balances in BasicToken holding token balances of every holder.
uint256 totalSupply_ stores total token supply, set once in the WLCoin constructor.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) internal allowed, the ERC20 allowance table.
string public constant name = "WLCoin".
string public constant symbol = "WAGS".
uint8 public constant decimals = 18, used in INITIAL_SUPPLY computation.
uint256 public constant INITIAL_SUPPLY = 20000000000 * 10**decimals, minted to the deployer.
library SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b): returns a*b and asserts c/a == b to guard overflow.
library SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b): integer division, reverts on division by zero.
library SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b): asserts b <= a then returns a - b, preventing underflow.
library SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b): returns a+b and asserts c >= a to guard overflow.
public view function returning totalSupply_.
public transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) moving tokens from msg.sender to _to using SafeMath.
public view balanceOf(address _owner) returning balances[_owner].
public transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) using and decrementing the allowance of msg.sender.
public approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) overwriting allowed[msg.sender][_spender] with _value (classic approval race condition).
public view allowance(address _owner, address _spender) returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
public increaseApproval(address _spender, uint _addedValue) adding to the current allowance with SafeMath.add.
public decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint _subtractedValue) subtracting from the allowance, clamping at zero.
constructor of WLCoin: sets totalSupply_ and assigns the whole INITIAL_SUPPLY balance to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
Attacker-controlled caller address used as balance owner, allowance owner and constructor recipient.
balances[msg.sender] = balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) in transfer: balance decrement guarded by SafeMath.sub.
balances[_to] = balances[_to].add(_value) in transfer: balance credit guarded by SafeMath.add.
balances[_from] = balances[_from].sub(_value) in transferFrom.
balances[_to] = balances[_to].add(_value) in transferFrom.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] = allowed[_from][msg.sender].sub(_value) in transferFrom, decrementing the caller allowance.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value in approve: unconditional overwrite enabling the approve/transferFrom race.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = allowed[msg.sender][_spender].add(_addedValue) in increaseApproval.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = oldValue.sub(_subtractedValue) (or 0) in decreaseApproval.
totalSupply_ = INITIAL_SUPPLY executed in the WLCoin constructor.
balances[msg.sender] = INITIAL_SUPPLY executed in the WLCoin constructor, minting the entire supply to the deployer.
uint256 c = a * b plus assert(c / a == b) inside SafeMath.mul, the multiplication overflow guard.
uint256 c = a + b plus assert(c >= a) inside SafeMath.add, the addition overflow guard.
assert(b <= a) followed by a - b inside SafeMath.sub, the subtraction underflow guard.
uint256 c = a / b inside SafeMath.div, division reverting on a zero divisor.
